The '''Regional Prefect's Pressure''' was a comfortable complex used by [[Regional Prefect]] [[Del Obarren]] and his staff in the [[o'beki]] of [[A'Lenba]] on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Security was provided by a force of twelve [[Goroth Planetary Police]]
